additionalInfo: PC changes songs; CC 81-96 are per-pattern triggers (not mix levels). Each pattern CC fires on any value change and switches at the end of the active sequence. Volume and other performance controls are handled on-device or via the analog expression pedal, not this fixed CC map. Step can send or receive clock and transport depending on Settings > MIDI. MIDI In accepts Type A or B TRS; configure PC In, CC In, and clock/transport separately in Settings > MIDI.
